question: Which of the following was NEVER used as a password to enter the Gryffindor common room? Options: A) Mimbulus Mimbletonia B) Banana Fritters C) Dissendium D) Fortuna Major
Which character has NOT canonically used the Mending Charm (Reparo) or one of its variants in the books? Options: A) Seamus Finnigan B) Draco Malfoy C) Bill Weasley D) Severus Snape

Why can Harry see Thestrals pulling the carriages in Order of the Phoenix but not in earlier books, despite witnessing death before? Options: A) He needed to comprehend Quirrell’s death from his first year B) He had to process Cedric Diggory’s death over the summer C) Killing the Basilisk in his second year unlocked the ability D) Witnessing his parents’ death as a baby finally took effect
answer: He had to process Cedric Diggory’s death over the summer

question: Which of the following statements about Aberforth Dumbledore is accurate? Options: A) He owns the Three Broomsticks and was never in the Order of the Phoenix B) He was expelled from Hogwarts for illegal charms on goats and was a member of the original Order of the Phoenix C) He taught at Hogwarts and helped hide the Philosopher’s Stone D) He dueled Grindelwald alongside Albus and won the Elder Wand
answer: None of the options are fully accurate

question: In which sequence did the following repairs using the Mending Charm occur chronologically across the books? Options: A) A table leg by Bill Weasley; a teacup by Hermione; a bowl in Herbology by Harry B) A teacup by Hermione; a table leg by Bill Weasley; a bowl in Herbology by Harry C) A bowl in Herbology by Harry; a table leg by Bill Weasley; a teacup by Hermione D) A table leg by Bill Weasley; a bowl in Herbology by Harry; a teacup by Hermione
answer: A teacup by Hermione; a table leg by Bill Weasley; a bowl in Herbology by Harry
